memoryHub.semanticOff: Off. Memory is searched by words and exact matches until an embedding model is set up.

review.title: Review
review.description: Things Saqina picked up from chats and agents. Nothing here is shared until you approve it.
review.emptyBody: New suggestions from your chats and agents appear here.
review.conflict: This may contradict an approved memory:
review.conflictChoice: What should happen to the older one?
review.needsChoice: Choose what happens to the conflicting memory first.

detail.deleteBody: It is removed for good, with its history and sources. It will not come back from an import.
detail.conflictOpen: Marked as possibly contradicting another memory.

jobs.title: Processing
jobs.description: Background work that reads chats and builds summaries.
jobs.restricted: Only project admins can see processing jobs.

bindings.title: Agent loadouts
bindings.description: Choose which approved memory an agent starts with. Access is checked again every time; a binding never overrides a removed permission.
bindings.empty: No loadouts yet. Agents only get what you bind here.

errors.conflict_unresolved: Choose what happens to the conflicting memory first.

wiki.title: Knowledge
wiki.description: What Saqina has read from your project documents. Passages keep the file, heading and lines they came from, so an answer can point to its source.
wiki.emptyBody: Project documents (PRD, plan, custom documents) and documents of the connected repository are read automatically. PDF and Office files are not read yet.
wiki.reindexQueued: Queued. It runs in the background.
wiki.searchPlaceholder: What do the documents say about…
wiki.noResults: No passage of the documents matches. Nothing is guessed.
wiki.degraded: Documents could not be searched right now.
wiki.stale: Source changed since it was read
wiki.semantic: Searched by words and exact matches. Semantic search is off.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Reusable workflows that proved useful. A skill says when to use it, when not to, the steps and how to check it worked. New skills are private until an admin approves sharing them.
skills.emptyBody: Write one, or let Saqina propose one after an agent finishes real work. Proposals wait here for review.

fields.name: Name
fields.exclusions: Do not use when (one per line)
fields.validation: How to check it worked (one per line)

issues.no_validation: No way to tell it worked
issues.contains_secret: Looks like it contains a secret
issues.risky_content: Contains a link, a command or wording that needs a careful look

skills.visibilityRequested: Sent for review. It stays unavailable to others until an admin approves.
skills.deleteBody: It is removed for good, with its versions and usage history.
skills.reviewHint: Only you can see a proposal until it is approved.

errors.contains_secret: This looks like it contains a secret. Remove it.

skills.runs: {ok} runs ended well, {bad} failed (not a verdict on the skill)

code.title: Code
code.description: The structure of your repository: where things are defined, what calls them and which files and tests a change may reach. Read from the connected GitHub repository at a stated commit.
code.note: Static analysis, best effort. It does not see dynamic calls, and “same name only” links may point at another symbol. It helps find the way; read the actual code before relying on it.
code.emptyBody: Connect a GitHub repository under Integrations and its code is read automatically. Other hosts are not supported yet.
code.reindexQueued: Queued. It runs in the background.
code.stale: The branch has a newer commit than this one
code.partial: Partly read: the repository has more files than one index holds
code.searchPlaceholder: A function, class or type name
code.noCallers: Nothing calls it that the graph can see.
code.unknownFile: That file is not in the index.
code.truncated: The lists are cut: there are more files than shown, or deeper levels than followed.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.description: Take your memory and skills with you, or bring some in. Nothing leaves or enters without a person.
transfer.exportBody: One JSON file with the approved memory and skills you can read, including your private ones and never anyone else's. Links into private chats are left out.
transfer.importBody: Everything imported becomes a private suggestion that waits in Review. Visibility, owner, approval and level in the file are ignored. Text that looks like a secret is refused, duplicates are skipped, and what was deleted or rejected before stays out.
transfer.done: Imported {memories} memories and {skills} skills. They are waiting in Review.
transfer.skipped: Skipped: {duplicate} duplicates, {blocked} refused, {removed} removed before, {invalid} not valid, {backlog} over the waiting limit.

errors.invalid: This is not a Saqina memory package.
errors.checksum: The file looks cut off or edited: its checksum does not match.
errors.too_many: Too many items for one import (200 at most). Split the file.
errors.too_large: The file is too large (1 MB at most).
